name: creative-brief
title_zh: 给设计师和 AI 生图的视觉方向简报，一句话就能开工
tagline_zh: 脑子里只有「夏天要卖爆」这种模糊念头时，它逼你把受众、单一卖点、调性和必须出现的画面元素一条条填满。
tagline_en: When all you have is a vague hunch like "make summer sell", it forces you to fill in audience, one core message.
desc_en: Generate a creative brief for a designer or an AI image tool, given a campaign idea or content angle. Use when the founder asks for a creative brief, wants to brief the design team, needs a prompt for an AI image generator, or has a campaign idea that needs visual direction. Triggers on phrases like "write a creative brief", "brief for the design team", "image prompt for this campaign", "what shou
why_zh: 它先追问再动笔：受众是谁、只准留一个卖点、什么调性、画面里必须有什么。缺一项就卡住不往下写。
why_en: It asks before it writes: who's the audience, which single message survives, what tone, what must appear on screen. Missing one.
limit_zh: 只产出文字简报，不生成图片、不做排版、不写投放文案；品牌调性、受众画像、卖点优先级都得你自己给，它不替你拍板。
limit_en: Text brief only: no images, no layout, no ad copy. You must supply brand tone, audience, and message priority yourself; it won't decide for you and.
title_en: A visual direction brief designers and AI image tools can.
